verdict.rationale: Devin ships a first-party hosted 'Devin MCP' server (docs-15/16/17, probe-3) that lets external clients/agents create sessions, manage playbooks/knowledge, and schedule tasks, satisfying the axis of connecting an agent via an official MCP server (in addition to Devin's own CLI supporting MCP client connections). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that third-party agents successfully connect and operate through this MCP server, and more detail on authentication/setup robustness.
